claim: Source and documentation review of hashicorp/nomad at commit 65a1c427bb3a91d767287bed8e16e45e13a715f0 (license NOASSERTION), read from README.md at that commit. Repository description: "Nomad is an easy-to-use, flexible, and performant workload orchestrator that can deploy a mix of microservice, batch, containerized, and non-containerized applications. Nomad is easy to operate and scale and has native Consul and Vault integrations.". Survived the landscape-sweep-20261006-vendor facts refuter and both fit refuters (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6-Astra); no native install, run or comparison with a winner.

documentation_excerpts.text: Nomad is a simple and flexible workload orchestrator to deploy and manage containers ([docker](https://developer.hashicorp.com/nomad/docs/deploy/task-driver/docker), [podman](https://developer.hashicorp.com/nomad/plugins/drivers/podman)), non-containerized applications ([executable](https://developer.hashicorp.com/nomad/docs/deploy/task-driver/exec), [Java](https://developer.hashicorp.com/nomad/docs/deploy/task-driver/java)), and virtual machines ([qemu](https://developer.hashicorp.com/nomad/doc
Nomad is supported on Linux, Windows, and macOS. A commercial version of Nomad, [Nomad Enterprise](https://developer.hashicorp.com/nomad/docs/enterprise), is also available.
